name: Card Construct VI
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

DESCRIPTION

You toss out a card and it grows in size turning into a CR 8 animated card, or 1d3 CR 6 animated cards. You can choose to summon a card swarm instead.
